description: The plot illustrates length extrapolation performance on the EgoSchema dataset by showing how accuracy changes with the number of video frames for four methods/settings. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Frames,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 8 to 64 frames, with major tick labels shown at 10-frame intervals (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60). The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)”, uses a linear scale, and ranges approximately from 39% to 54%, with visible major ticks every 2 percentage points (e.g., 40, 42, 44, …, 54). The blue line with circular markers (solid line), labeled “Ours (Dynamic Seg),” starts near 52.9% at 8 frames, rises to about 54.0% at 16 frames, and then stays near 53.8–53.9% at 32 frames and about 53.7–53.8% at 64 frames. The green line with circular markers (solid line), labeled “Ours (Static 4-Seg),” begins around 52.6% at 8 frames, increases to roughly 53.6% at 16 frames, and remains close to about 53.8–53.9% at 32 and 64 frames. The orange line with square markers (solid line), labeled “PLLaVA (DP 8),” decreases across the x-axis from about 45.0% at 8 frames to about 43.0% at 16 frames, about 41.0% at 32 frames, and around 39.5% at 64 frames. The red line with square markers (solid line), labeled “PLLaVA (DP 16),” is plotted at 16, 32, and 64 frames, dropping from about 45.6% at 16 frames to roughly 43.8% at 32 frames and about 42.1% at 64 frames.
